experiment.selection: No arm or seed winner selection. Fixed v2 TCN Micro. Each checkpoint minimizes unweighted validation joint NLL; risk/threshold selected on calibration only; all eight arms reported on test.
experiment.primary_target: Unchanged v2 fixed crossing E/D; factorized BCE plus conditional direction CE, common known-root denominator. Risk grid never changes target.
experiment.context_contract: Regular 5s roots retained. Restored resets on date, clock gap or physical quote support transition only. Missing historical X has zero values and finite masks, clock_row_present=1 inside supported history; padding/support absent flag=0. No forward fill or time compression. No extra X channels.
experiment.weighting_contract: TRAIN mature available roots only; count long/short witness ID memberships including BOTH. Inverse ID multiplicity, mean of two inverse counts for BOTH; normalize within each positive joint class to preserve four class masses. NONE=1. Uniform permutations. mean(weight * [BCE+conditional CE]) over root count. Unweighted validation/test probability metrics.
experiment.feature_clock: 64 five-second roots; TCN RF61 = 300 seconds detailed history. Same 70 feature values and 141 model input channels in all arms.
experiment.day_context: Primary Micro omits day/VWAP/STFT channels. Rich 225 family retained as data artifact only, not fit in this experiment.
experiment.historical_exposure: New dates relative to scientific-v2. Existing cognition recipe historically assigns June to train and July to validation; never-inspected holdout is not claimed.
experiment.paired_diagnostics: Same initial state, uniform batch order, scaler, cohort and probes per seed; report context/weight effects, interaction and day-paired descriptive intervals. Event-balanced diagnostics do not imply profitability.
